name: impeccable
author: Paul Bakaus
description: Design skills, commands, and anti-pattern detection for AI coding agents

scripts.build: node scripts/fetch-public-skill.mjs && bun run build:skills && bun run build:site && cp -R dist build/_data/dist && node scripts/strip-local-world-cards.mjs
scripts.build:release: node scripts/fetch-public-skill.mjs && bun run build:skills:release && bun run build:site && cp -R dist build/_data/dist
scripts.rebuild: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.rebuild:release: bun run clean && bun run build:release
scripts.dev: node scripts/fetch-public-skill.mjs && bun run scripts/gen-dev-api.mjs && npx astro dev
scripts.preview: bun run build && npx astro preview
scripts.deploy: node scripts/fetch-public-skill.mjs --force && node scripts/sync-api-data.mjs && bun run build && node scripts/fetch-public-skill.mjs --assert-public && wrangler pages deploy build/
scripts.build:pro: node scripts/fetch-public-skill.mjs && npx astro build --config pro/astro.config.mjs
scripts.deploy:pro: bun run build:pro && wrangler pages deploy --cwd pro
scripts.d1:pro:schema: wrangler d1 execute DB -c pro/wrangler.toml --remote --file pro/schema.sql
scripts.d1:pro:schema:local: wrangler d1 execute DB -c pro/wrangler.toml --local --file pro/schema.sql
scripts.d1:pro:count: wrangler d1 execute DB -c pro/wrangler.toml --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS signups FROM waitlist"
scripts.d1:pro:export: wrangler d1 execute DB -c pro/wrangler.toml --remote --json --command "SELECT email, source, country, created_at FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('impeccable-site is not the npm package. cli/ here is materialized from public main and this manifest trails it (3.2.1 vs 3.4.0). Publish and tag the CLI from pbakaus/impeccable.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.catalog:round: npm run validate:catalog && npm run world-cards && npm run catalog:status
